localizedDescriptions.zh: 下载旧版IPA并安装。支持自定义plist（自建/代理/Scripting）、Keychain存密码、搜索带国家、源头协议、免更新开关、调试日志。原作社区脚本：https://github.com/ScriptingApp/Community-Scripts/raw/refs/heads/main/IPA-Tool.scripting ；维护：IamNewHands。
localizedDescriptions.en: Download old IPA builds and install them. Custom plist, Keychain passwords, country-aware search, upstream Apple auth, disable update check, debug logging toggle. Original community script: https://github.com/ScriptingApp/Community-Scripts/raw/refs/heads/main/IPA-Tool.scripting ; maintained by IamNewHands.
